name: Strawberry Banana Smoothie
steps: Rinse, hull and halve strawberries; peel and slice bananas. Chill the fruit before blending for a thicker drink.
Blend strawberries and bananas with yogurt and half the milk until all fruit pieces disappear.
Add remaining milk, honey and lemon juice; blend just until creamy and taste for sweet–tart balance.
Pour equally into four chilled glasses and drink immediately so the banana does not darken.
tips: For a colder, thicker smoothie, freeze the banana slices beforehand.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
